name: agents-pro
description: Professional specialist agents: security and prompt-injection review, PII detection, architecture and staff-level system review, the pre-activation guardian gate, ADR and specification authors, research analysts and infrastructure roles. Use when a task needs a named expert rather than a generalist — an OWASP/STRIDE pass, an architectural fitness review, a decision recorded as an ADR, or the last gate before an artifact is activated. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
